scripts.setup: npm install && npx -w apps/demo playwright install chromium && cd apps/worker && uv sync && uv run playwright install chromium
scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,demo,clean,demo2,clean2,worker -c blue,magenta,cyan,yellow,gray,green "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/demo" "npm run dev:clean -w apps/demo" "npm run dev -w apps/demo2" "npm run dev:clean -w apps/demo2" "cd apps/worker && uv run worker"
scripts.test: npm run test --workspaces && cd apps/worker && uv run pytest
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspaces && npm run lint --workspaces && cd apps/worker && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.verify-bugs: npm run verify-bugs -w apps/demo && npm run verify-bugs -w apps/demo2
scripts.bench: cd apps/worker && uv run worker bench
